name: jev-pilot
description: Lets TypeSafe Jev take routine steps, route effort, gate risky calls and check that work is done.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: active applies Jev's decisions, shadow only logs them, off disables the mod.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Per-turn routing by difficulty: lower effort, also switch to a cheaper model, or off.

takeSteps.title: Take steps
takeSteps.description: Let Jev make routine tool calls (Read, git, project scripts) instead of Claude.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Let Jev tighten permissions on risky or out-of-scope Bash and edits.

doneCheck.title: Done check
doneCheck.description: Let Jev send Claude back once when a request looks unfinished.

takeThreshold.title: Take threshold
takeThreshold.description: Minimum probability for Jev to take a step itself.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Also take steps and route effort inside subagent loops.

dangerAsk.title: Gate: ask at
dangerAsk.description: Ask before a Bash command when its probability of being dangerous is at least this.

dangerDeny.title: Gate: deny at
dangerDeny.description: Deny a dangerous Bash command (this probability or more) when it is also out of scope.

scopeDeny.title: Gate: out of scope below
scopeDeny.description: A Bash command counts as out of scope below this in-scope probability.

editScope.title: Gate: edit scope below
editScope.description: Ask before an edit whose in-scope probability is below this.

doneThreshold.title: Done check: unfinished below
doneThreshold.description: Send Claude back when the probability that the work is finished is below this.

bypass.title: Answer simple prompts without Claude
bypass.description: When a prompt only needs one read-only action Jev takes (run the tests, git status, read a file), a small model reports the result and the main Claude model is skipped.

classify.title: Classify prompts
classify.description: Classify each prompt and add a hint Claude reads when a skill fits or the change needs a plan first.

agentTypes.title: Pick subagent types
agentTypes.description: Let Jev switch a general-purpose subagent to a specialised type when it is confident.

compaction.title: Guide compaction
compaction.description: Before a compaction, tell the summarizer which earlier tool results to keep in detail.
